notes: All 55 trophies are single-player; there are no online trophies. 28 trophies are hidden on PlayStation until earned. Only one trophy is potentially missable: Positive Mental Attitude. Cheats disable trophies and saving, so play clean.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The Platinum unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is nothing to do for this one directly. Work through the roadmap in order: story first, then stranger strands, activities and counts, crime and robberies, and finally the 100% completion cleanup. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter so a missable step can be redone.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 PS5 trophies revealed

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play through the opening mission, Gone Fishing, at the start of Chapter 1. This is the first story mission of the game, so it unlocks naturally as you play and cannot be missed. No preparation is needed; just follow the mission prompts to the end.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 trophy guide & platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. Before you leave Chapter 1, make sure you have meditated at the Chapter 1 meditation spot for Positive Mental Attitude, because one spot is only available in this chapter and there is no mission replay. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter as insurance.

sources.name: GTA Vibes — trophy list, roadmap & missables

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Play through all of Chapter 2's story missions until the chapter closes. Story trophies cannot be missed; they unlock by playing the story. Save at the start of the chapter so you can return if you ever need to redo a step inside it.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 trophy guide & platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete every story mission in Chapter 3. As with the other chapter trophies, this one unlocks by playing the story and cannot be missed. Between missions, use the downtime to chip away at activities and collectibles that stay available in free roam.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 trophy guide & platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish all of Chapter 4's story missions. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale, and like the others it cannot be missed. Before you start the final mission, make a manual save, since the final mission is the point of no return for the story.

sources.name: GTA Vibes — trophy list, roadmap & missables

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story. It unlocks after Chapter 4, so just keep playing the story to the end; it cannot be missed. Make a manual save before starting it, both as a safety net and because the post-story free roam that follows is where most of the remaining trophies are finished.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 trophy guide & platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Mission trophies unlock by playing the story and cannot be missed, so simply follow the mission through to its end. If you are tracking story progress, this is one of the early mission trophies on the way to the chapter trophies.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Like every mission trophy, it unlocks by playing the story and cannot be missed. Heist missions tend to be longer set pieces, so follow the objectives carefully and use the mission's checkpoints if a section goes wrong.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It unlocks by playing the story and cannot be missed. Nothing special is required beyond finishing the mission itself.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. This is a story mission trophy, so it unlocks naturally and cannot be missed. Keep playing the story and it will pop when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. It unlocks by playing the story and cannot be missed. The VCIA airport setting also matters for the Catch Me If You Can trophy, so remember the layout for later free-roam attempts.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Like all mission trophies, it unlocks by playing the story and cannot be missed. Finish the mission and the trophy follows.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion, which is the last big step before the Platinum. It counts the story, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and other checklist items, so it is earned by finishing almost everything else in this guide first. Work through the roadmap stages in order and use the final cleanup stage to mop up whatever the completion tracker still lists.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 trophy guide & platinum roadmap
GTA Vibes — trophy list, roadmap & missables

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts in total across the game, in story missions or free roam. Stunts build up naturally from jumps, near misses and airborne driving, so this is a long grind best done steadily rather than in one sitting. It can all be done after the story in free roam, so there is no rush and nothing to miss.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every type of activity in the game at least once: the activities include the shooting range, drone races, races, fishing, arcade games, bowling and the other open-world pastimes listed in this guide. You only need to try each one, not master it, so sample them as you come across them. Everything stays available in free roam after the story.

sources.name: GTA Vibes — trophy list, roadmap & missables

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge; PlayStation tracks 42 challenges for this trophy. Visit the shooting range in free roam and work through the challenges one by one, learning each range's targets and timing. Golds are a skill check, so repeat a challenge until the gold threshold is met rather than rushing through them all at once.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 trophy guide & platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every drone race location across Leonida. Find the race markers in free roam, learn each course's gates and shortcuts, and win at each spot in turn. All locations remain available after the story, so this is a free-roam activity with nothing missable about it.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Races are found around Leonida in free roam, and each distinct race only needs one win, so spread your attempts across different events rather than repeating the same one. Pick a fast, well-handling vehicle and learn each route before committing to a win attempt.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are one of the game's activities, and Cal is the rival angler to out-fish; take the challenge when it is offered and outscore him. If you lose, the challenge can be retried, so it is not missable.

sources.name: GTA Vibes — trophy list, roadmap & missables

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game. Find an arcade machine in free roam, start a game, and play it through to completion. Only one full completion is needed, so pick whichever arcade game you find easiest and finish it.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Andy's stranger mission strand. Stranger strands open up as you meet each character around Leonida, and each strand ends with a final mission that awards its trophy. Follow Andy's strand to its end; it can be finished after the story in free roam.

sources.name: GTA Vibes — trophy list, roadmap & missables

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Kenton's stranger mission strand. Meet Kenton in the world, work through his strand of missions, and finish the last one. Like the other stranger strands, this can be done after the story in free roam.

sources.name: GTA Vibes — trophy list, roadmap & missables

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Billy's stranger mission strand. Work through Billy's missions as they appear and finish the strand's last mission. Stranger strands stay available in free roam after the story, so there is no deadline.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 trophy guide & platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. The named strands in this list are Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret and Cal, and there are more strangers to find in the world. Explore the map, take every stranger mission you find, and finish eight full strands to earn this silver.

sources.name: GTA Vibes — trophy list, roadmap & missables

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Randy's stranger mission strand. Find Randy, work through his strand, and finish its last mission. It counts toward the 8 strands needed for Strangers & Freaks, and it can be done after the story in free roam.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 trophy guide & platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Tyrone's stranger mission strand. Follow Tyrone's strand to its conclusion in free roam. It also counts toward the 8 stranger strands for Strangers & Freaks.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 trophy guide & platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida. This is the ONLY potentially missable trophy in the game: one meditation spot is only available in Chapter 1, and there is no mission replay, so meditate at that spot before you finish Chapter 1 or the trophy is locked out for that playthrough. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter, and one before the final mission, so you can go back if you miss a spot.

sources.name: GTA Vibes — trophy list, roadmap & missables

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret as part of his stranger mission strand. Take Bret's strand when it appears, follow the hunt, and take down the unique animal he asks for. It can be done after the story in free roam and counts toward the stranger strands for Strangers & Freaks.

sources.name: GTA Vibes — trophy list, roadmap & missables

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets by finding cards scattered around Leonida. Cards are a free-roam collectible, so explore thoroughly and pick them up as you travel; sets complete as you gather every card in them. Three full sets are needed for this silver, and nothing about the cards is missable after the story.

sources.name: GTA Vibes — trophy list, roadmap & missables

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK feature at 100 different locations across Leonida. WAiNK spots are spread all over the map, so this is a long exploration grind best combined with the other collectible hunts and the full exploration for The Goodtime State. Each location only counts once, so keep moving to new spots rather than repeating one.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 trophy guide & platinum roadmap

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges in total. Challenges cover the game's many side activities, so they accumulate naturally as you work through races, stunts, the shooting range and the other activities in this guide. Check the in-game challenge list in free roam and target the easiest unfinished ones to reach 50.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then lose the cops and escape. Work with your partner in free roam, cause enough trouble to reach 4 stars, then break line of sight and hide until the wanted level clears. Pick open ground with escape routes rather than a dead end.

sources.name: GTA Vibes — trophy list, roadmap & missables

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner while keeping your wanted level the whole time. Plan a route past three nearby shops, rob each one in turn without letting the wanted level drop between them, and keep moving so the police do not catch you mid-run. If the wanted level clears, start the run over.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles across Leonida. Vehicles count when you encounter and register them, so drive everywhere, try new districts and vehicle types, and check off new finds as you go. This pairs well with exploring the whole map for The Goodtime State and with registering vehicles for On the Spot.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 trophy guide & platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during a single use of Combat Focus. Set it up where enemies cluster, trigger Combat Focus, and drop five targets before it ends. A busy shootout or a wanted-level standoff gives you the targets you need; pick your moment rather than wasting the ability on one or two enemies.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from VCIA, the Vice City airport. Get to the airport in free roam and leave in a way the airport did not schedule, such as taking off in an aircraft without following the normal departure. Experiment at the airfield until the trophy pops.

sources.name: GTA Vibes — trophy list, roadmap & missables

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: This trophy is about the Rhino tanks: get into a Rhino and survive the heat it brings. Raise a high wanted level in free roam until the military responds with Rhinos, then deal with the tanks, by taking one over or surviving their assault. Keep moving and use cover, since a Rhino's cannon ends a standoff fast.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store first, move quietly, avoid cameras and staff sightlines, and get out with the goods before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails, so leave and try again rather than fighting your way out.

sources.name: GTA Vibes — trophy list, roadmap & missables

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank vaults are found around Leonida; hit one, crack the vault, grab the cash and escape the police response before moving on to the next. Plan a fast getaway vehicle for each hit, since the escape is part of the trophy.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 trophy guide & platinum roadmap

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks travel the roads of Leonida in free roam; intercept one, stop it, take the cash, and lose the police that respond. Bring a fast getaway car and pick a quiet stretch of road so the robbery itself is quick.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore every area of Leonida. Drive, fly and walk into each region of the map until the whole state is uncovered, combining this with the WAiNK locations, vehicle discoveries and card hunts so one trip covers several trophies. The in-game map shows what is still unexplored, so sweep the corners last.

sources.name: GTA Vibes — trophy list, roadmap & missables

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang in Leonida. Find each gang's operations around the map, hit one per gang, and escape with the take. Work through the gangs one at a time in free roam, since every gang needs its own robbery for the trophy.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 trophy guide & platinum roadmap

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to Ocean Beach in free roam, find a spot with a view over the water, and order a cocktail there. This is a relaxed free-roam moment, so take it when you are passing the beach for other trophies.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a vehicle through a showroom's frontage and out the other side, the way the classic scene plays. Pick a showroom with a clear run-up, build speed, and crash straight through the glass.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a game of bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through on your throws. Find the alley in free roam, start a game, and finish it. A full game is all it takes, and it also counts as one of the activity types for Master of None.

sources.name: GTA Vibes — trophy list, roadmap & missables

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: This trophy is about a partnership moment with mass appeal: play through the partner storyline beats that build your duo's reputation until this one pops. It is tied to story and partner progress, so keep playing the partner missions and side content together. It cannot be missed by playing the story through.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: This trophy tracks the choices you make across the game. Keep making decisions in missions and in the world, for better or worse, and the trophy unlocks once the count is reached. It builds up over a full playthrough, so there is nothing to force and nothing to miss.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 trophy guide & platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try at something you first failed. Fail an attempt at an activity or challenge, then succeed at the very next retry, and the trophy pops. It is a light-hearted one: just retry anything you fluff and win the second time around.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange in Leonida. The state hides odd sights and encounters, so explore off the beaten path, visit unusual places at odd hours, and keep your eyes open while you travel. It unlocks when you stumble on one of the game's strange events.

sources.name: GTA Vibes — trophy list, roadmap & missables

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by. Drive slowly past a pedestrian, lean out and strike them with a melee attack from the moving vehicle. Pick a quiet street with a lone pedestrian so you can line the hit up cleanly.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies and heists, so keep laundering the take through your contacts as you work through the crime trophies. The total builds across the whole game, and it pairs naturally with the bank vaults and shop robberies.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 trophy guide & platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in Leonida. Buy weapons, clothes, vehicles and upgrades as you play, and the total adds up over a full playthrough. If you are close near the end, top it up with a big purchase such as a vehicle or a weapon stock-up.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase every garage property available in Leonida. Garage properties are bought with in-game money as they appear on the market, so keep an eye on property listings and buy each garage when you can afford it. It is a free-roam purchase trophy with nothing missable about it.

sources.name: GTA Vibes — trophy list, roadmap & missables

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find different vehicles around Leonida, open the Scooter Bros app, and register each one. Ten distinct registrations are needed, so keep registering new vehicles as you discover them, which also helps toward Whip It Good.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 trophy guide & platinum roadmap

roadmap.title: Story — Chapters 1–4 and the final mission
roadmap.text: Play the story through Chapters 1–4 and the final mission. Before you finish Chapter 1, meditate at the Chapter 1 meditation spot for Positive Mental Attitude. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter and one before the final mission.

roadmap.title: Stranger & side-mission strands
roadmap.text: Finish the stranger strands: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret and Cal, until 8 strands are complete for Strangers & Freaks.

roadmap.title: Activities & counts
roadmap.text: 250 stunts, gold medals in the shooting range challenges, drone race wins at every location, 20 race wins, 50 challenges, 100 vehicles discovered, WAiNK at 100 locations, and 3 collectible card sets.

roadmap.title: Crime & robberies
roadmap.text: Bank vaults, an armored truck, a jewelry store, shop robberies, illegal operations for each gang, and laundering marked bills.

roadmap.title: Cleanup & 100% completion
roadmap.text: Mop up whatever is left, reach 100% completion for A Long Road, and the Platinum pops.
